scope: Implemented, contract-tested and independent tensor/rigid-invariant source receiving; not installed packages, platform matrix, human visual/Qt acceptance or candidate approval.

contract.reference: Fixed independent atom population in the stated selection structure; may overlap or be disjoint from moving atoms.
contract.center: Keep the initial weighted reference center or subtract without restoration. Excluded reference atoms remain unchanged.
contract.target: Cartesian basis or nine unit-free values as three right-handed orthonormal row vectors.
contract.validation: Review parses/resolves without eigensolve or trajectory copy. Flag-free native validation computes and checks all selected structures before publication.
contract.limits: Native eigenvalue ordering, arbitrary eigenvector signs and degeneracy criteria remain authoritative. No temporal sign continuity, periodic reconstruction, lattice rotation or numerical fallback.
contract.effects: Managed current-system edit/sync or complete independent system; only requested atoms and distinct ordered structures change. Native coverage invalidation and synchronization-only retry.

html.scope: HTML compilation with six retained baseline underline warnings; saved outputs and no autosummary regeneration.
